description: Firm headcount for an offsite catering quote; the first message never says which offsite or the session counts. DISTILL-CANARY-47e0a95b

turns.prompt: Selbourne Analytics is holding the catering quote open until we send a firm number for the offsite. How many people are we catering for?

It is the spring offsite: 18 people were there in the morning and 11 in the afternoon, and 4 of the morning group stayed on for the afternoon as well. Count each person once. How many should the catering cover? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer.
